import chess,subprocess,random
r=random.Random(80)
for j in range(4):
 b=chess.Board()
 for i in range(20+j*20):
  if b.is_game_over():break
  b.push(r.choice(list(b.legal_moves)))
 def pf(b,d):
  if d==0:return 1
  n=0
  for m in b.legal_moves:
   b.push(m);n+=pf(b,d-1);b.pop()
  return n
 v=pf(b,3)
 out=subprocess.check_output(['./engine','perft','3'],input=b.fen()+'\n',text=True)
 print(b.fen(),v,out.strip().splitlines()[-1]);assert v==int(out.strip().split()[-1])

cat > autoplay.py <<'PY'
import arena,subprocess,sys,time
seconds=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else '45';steps=int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 5
for _ in range(steps):
 b=arena.load_board()
 if arena.result(b):arena.show(b);break
 out=subprocess.check_output(['./engine',seconds],input=b.fen()+'\n',text=True)
 print('\nPosition',b.fullmove_number,b.fen(),flush=True)
 print('\n'.join(out.strip().splitlines()[-4:]),flush=True)
 m=out.strip().splitlines()[-1].split()[-1]
 if m not in [m.uci() for m in b.legal_moves]: raise Exception(m)
 arena.cmd_move(m);sys.stdout.flush()
